comment: 1.0.2 ribbon (owner decisions 14/11/2026): per-tab scaling order that keeps labels as long as possible, L -> M (small icons, label right, even 3-row grid) -> S (icons only, same grid) -> C (the group becomes its 'Caption ▾' button). 'steps' replace the steps of that tab's ladder in vcl/inc/HstRibbonLadders.hxx (from scaling-priorities.json); a group not named in a state skips it. Edit freely: scripts/patches/generate-ribbon-adaptive-ladders.py writes hst-ribbon-adaptive-ladders.patch from this file. Defaults: the order of the approved mockup (ribbon-1-0-3.html, v2) for Writer's Home and Insert tabs.
